content: vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices device ordering is not guaranteed stable/consistent across systems (e.g. Linux can report iGPU before dGPU even when dGPU is primary); relying on a fixed index is unsafe. Recommended pattern is scoring/rating each physical device's properties (discrete > integrated, required features/limits present) and picking the best match rather than index 0, which also gives two independent Vulkan clients in one process (MNN and a render module) a basis for consistently landing on the same physical device without explicit IPC coordination.
